sessions.phase_label: Technical shoot planning and setup confirmation

requirements.title: Still Photography of the Triptych
requirements.definition: Photograph the three 8x10-inch artwork panels according to the supplied still-image shot list.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers required still-image coverage of the artwork; resolution and file-package delivery are separate, while individual shot-list views remain attributes because the unavailable shot list provides no evidence that they evolve independently.

requirements.title: Edited Triptych Walkthrough Video
requirements.definition: Produce a short 4K walkthrough video assembled into one 20–40 second edit from footage of each panel individually and all three panels together.
requirements.boundary_note: Individual-panel and combined-triptych clips are required inputs to one edited walkthrough deliverable rather than independently evolving Requirements.

requirements.title: Full-Resolution Still File Delivery
requirements.definition: Deliver the full-resolution still-image package, including the requested RAW files and standard edited high-resolution versions.
requirements.boundary_note: File resolution and requested RAW/edited variants are attributes of one delivery package; delivery is separate from whether the previewed photographs meet visual capture requirements.

requirements.title: Ninety-Degree Square Capture
requirements.definition: Capture the tabletop artwork from a locked 90-degree top-down position so the resulting shots remain square and level.
requirements.boundary_note: The 90-degree angle and square framing form one tightly coupled geometric capture mechanism; lighting and presentation-surface requirements can change independently.

requirements.title: Controlled Softbox Lighting
requirements.definition: Provide and use suitable diffused softbox lighting for clean, controlled tabletop capture of the artwork.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers controlled diffused illumination and the required lighting equipment; camera geometry and the black presentation surface are separately testable constraints.

requirements.title: Black Velvet Tabletop Presentation
requirements.definition: Display the artwork on the client-provided black velvet tabletop for the documented still and video capture.
requirements.boundary_note: The specified presentation surface can be changed independently of lighting, camera angle, or output coverage and therefore remains its own constraint.
